title: Has anyone felt sick this past week?
content: I have been so tired, constant migraines mostly starting when the sun fully sets . I’ve been extremely cold . (I’m usually always cold ) but this is a new type of cold to where it will be 90 degrees and I’m shivering (I’ve taken my temp and it’s ranged 95.2 Fahrenheit- 96.1 Fahrenheit) my temp has never been that low before . It feels like I have the flu except my temperature is really low almost hypothermic… once in a while I’ll get extreme hot flashes also. I don’t know if these are physical symptoms from all the mental processing and whatever is going on in “Mall World “ or if there is a new virus ..
